lines: Flowerhorns are becoming popular as pets.
A flowerhorn is a kind of fish.
It has a flower-like horn on its head.

That is because people created it.

body.text: Flowerhorns are becoming popular as pets. What is a flowerhorn, then? A flowerhorn is a kind of fish. It has a flower-like horn on its head. A flowerhorn lives only in an aquarium. That is because people created it. A flowerhorn is about 25 centimeters long. It has vivid colors like red, orange, and yellow. It looks cute and friendly. But a flowerhorn is hot-tempered. It likes to fight! Do you want to test a flowerhorn? Put your finger into the water tank and move it. The flowerhorn will follow your finger and bite it!
